On Wed, Jun 9, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great to kick this off. A quick summary of the immediate access items we need to get your staging environment ready for Redwood:
> 
> - SSO/SAML: metadata (IdP XML) or IdP issuer + ACS URL + certificate for verification.

Hi all — quick technical checklist and what we'll need from StellaWorks for staging prep. I’ve kept the requests explicit so the onboarding window is predictable.

SAML (staging):
- IdP metadata XML OR the following: Issuer/EntityID, ACS URL, SingleLogout URL (if used), and X.509 certificate (PEM).
- Expected NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
- Attribute mappings (minimum): email, givenName, familyName, groups

SCIM (staging):
- Endpoint: https://staging.stellaworks.com/api/scim/v2 (confirmed)
- Auth: bearer token — please generate a scoped token with only the following scopes: Users:write, Users:read, Groups:read
- Sample user payload (we'll use Katelyn's CSV; Monica will author a canonical JSON test user)
- PATCH support preferred; if not available we'll fall back to PUT

IP allowlist / testing connectivity:
- We will initiate connections from Redwood test runners at these IPs: 18.205.32.0/27 (will be added to our test config)
- Please add our staging test block for a 72-hour window and let us know any preferred maintenance windows.
- Recommended TTL for entries: 7 days for the initial cutover, then reduce to 30 days as a baseline for monitoring changes

Service accounts & RBAC:
- Naming suggestion: redwood-scim-provisioner-{env} (e.g., redwood-scim-provisioner-staging)
- Minimum privileges: create/update users, read users, read groups

Test plan / success criteria (for staging cutover):
- SAML auth flow completes for 3 test users (okta -> Redwood session)
- SCIM provisioning creates 1 user, updates email & group attributes, and deprovisions a test account
- Smoke tests against the API return 200 within acceptable latency (<300ms)

I can produce the SP metadata file (with ACS URL and EntityID) if you need it; otherwise please push the IdP metadata and the SCIM token to the secure channel we agree on.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Security & Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
